Vacant posts of PGTs and TGTs in
KVS
†*381. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
SHRI GHANSHYAM
CHANDRA KHARWAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 2809, given in the Rajya Sabha
on the 14th December, 2001, and state:
(a) Kendriya Vidyalayas (including
divisions) in which the posts of TGT in
Biology, Hindi, Social Science, English
and  PGT in Biology, Hindi, History have
been lying vacant; and
(b) what are the Vidyalaya-wise (not
at all India level) details thereof?
Over-bridge at Giddalur Railway
Station
*382.SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND
RAIAH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
construct a foot over-bridge and to raise
the platform at Giddalur Railway Station
in South-Central Railway, for the
convenience of old, sick, children and
ladies in confinement;
(b) if so, the allocation proposed to be
made for the purpose; and
(c) by when the work on the project is
proposed to be taken-up and the target for
completion of the same?
KVKs in Karnataka
*383. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Karnataka Government
has requested the Central Government to
sanction new Krishi Vigyan Kendras in
eleven districts; and
(b) if so, what steps are proposed to
be taken by Government to establish
Krishi Vigyan Kendras in the newly
formed districts of that State?
Standard of school education

SHARDA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that standard of

country is deteriorating day by day;

Gramin Mahila Mandal
†*385. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) what are Government's guidelines
for the upliftment of Gramin Mahila
Mandals;
(b) the details of assistance being
provided by Government to Gramin
Mahila Mandals;
(c) whether Government have received
some representations from the Pradhan,
Mahila Mandal, Nandala, Tehsil
Chardhgaon, Himachal Pradesh, in regard
to Mahila Mandal Bhawan; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Nutritious Noon Meal Scheme in
States
*386. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the Nutritious Noon Meal Scheme of the
Tamil Nadu Government;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to introduce such schemes all over
the country, through their financial
assistance;
(c) if not, whether Government would
also assist financially such schemes in
States where it is already existing; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Parent-Teacher Associations in KVS
*387. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Academic Advisory Committee, at its
19th meeting held on 22nd November,
2001, took a decision to modify the
process of election of members of the
Parent-Teacher Associations in Kendriya
Vidyalayas, substituting the democratic
right of election by nomination by the
Vidyalaya Management Committee;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the Federation of Kendriya
Vidyalaya P.T.As, Kerala, has passed a
resolution requesting the Kendriya
Vidyalaya Sangathan to withdraw such
amendment/modification; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?

SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:

pleased to state:
(a) whether the Railways are
considering to provide mobile police posts
on 24 express trains/passenger trains to
check the activities of inter-State dacoit
gangs, committing various offences and
terrorising passengers, by resorting to
looting;
(b) if so, in which trains;

Conservation of coastal and marine
environment
*390. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose
to prepare an action plan for conservation
of coastal and marine environment;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of achievements made
by Government in this field during the last
five years?
Railway corporation for Chennai
MRTS
*391. SHRIMATI S. G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any proposal for setting-
up of a separate railway corporation for
Chennai Mass Rapid Transport System is
under consideration;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Payment  of medical bills in KVS
†*392. SHRI GHANSHYAM
CHANDRA KHARWAR:
SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that uniform
procedure or fixed time-frame for
payment of medical bills to teachers/
employees of KVS has not been laid

time is taken arbitrarily by Principals in
KVS in different regions, including
Nasirabad for payment of medical bills
of teachers and employees; and
(d) if so, the details of complaints
received in this regard and the remedial
steps taken?

state:

Container depots of CCI
*394. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the names of container depots
managed by the Container Corporation
and their turnover/profit for the last three
years;
(b) how many private container depots
are there in the country and their turnover
and their net profit during the same period;
(c) the reasons for which the Railways
do not encourage the private sector to set
up container depots; and
(d) the reasons for investing Rs. 1400
crore in expansion by Container
Corporation of India, when the PSU is
slated for disinvestment?
Duties on Indian steel imports by US
†*395. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
2111, given in the Rajya Sabha on
7th December, 2001, and state how many
times the rates of import duty on steel
were increased by  USA during the  period
from March, 1998 to February, 2002, and
how much the same has been increased
in each case alongwith the details of its
effect on the steel trade of India?
Non-cleaning of lakes
†*396. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the beauty
of  lakes in the country is vanishing due
to non-cleaning of lakes particularly those
close to tourist places, and rapidly
increasing tendency of poaching the birds;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is  a fact that the amount
allocated by Government for cleaning the
lakes is, most of the times, spent on papers
and the said amount is misused; and
(d) if so, whether Government would
introduce intensive campaign for
cleanliness of lakes, ponds and rivers?
Express train between Nandyal and
Secunderabad
*397. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the metre gauge express
trains running between Nandyal and
Secunderabad in Andhra Pradesh, were
withdrawn after conversion of the track
into  broad gauge;
(b) if so, the reasons for not
introducing direct express train from
Nandyal to Secunderabad, after the
conversion; and
(c) the action taken to help passengers
of the area, suffering in the absence of
any direct train?

Power generation facilities at FCI,
Ramagundam
*398. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request has been
received in the Ministry of Chemicals
and Fertilizers from Andhra Pradesh
Government to provide suitable technical
consultancy, to prepare a detailed techno-
economic study with regard to utilisation
of facilities available at Fertilizer
Corporation of India (FCI), Ramagundam,
for power generation;
(b) if so, when such request was
received;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Andhra
Pradesh Power Generation Corporation
Ltd. (APGENCO) is ready to assist the
technical consultants appointed by the
Government of India; and
(d) if so, the reasons for delay in
appointing the technical consultants?
Agricultural researches
†*399. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a declining trend in agricultural
research in the country during the past few
years;
(b) if not, the respective number of
successful agricultural researches during
1999, 2000 and 2001; and
(c) the names of foodgrains to which
these researches were related?
Food processing projects of Andhra
Pradesh
*400. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have received
proposals for food processing projects
from Andhra Pradesh, during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof, year-wise;
(c) the financial assistance released for
these projects to the State under
Government's Plan schemes; and
(d) what is the present status of these
projects?
